content_record.title: Targeting senescence: the new precision arsenal against aging
content_record.editorial_body: A systematic review maps senolytics, senomorphics, and metabolic mimetics—plus AI-driven discovery—to redefine healthspan. Three things to remember - Senolytics like dasatinib + quercetin clear senescent cells. - Senomorphics such as rapamycin suppress the SASP phenotype. - Caloric restriction mimetics boost autophagy and mitochondrial function. Source This signal is based on Insights into the therapeutic strategies for aging and aging-associated diseases. from PubMed. Read the original report for full context. Health note: Preclinical promise; human efficacy and safety remain unproven.
